mapper.select: select * from appointment

SELECT a.*, a.auto_assigned AS autoAssigned, a.reschedule_window_expires AS rescheduleWindowExpires, d.name AS doctorName, d.title AS doctorTitle, s.schedule_date AS scheduleDate, s.time_slot AS timeSlot, s.slot_type AS slotType FROM appointment a LEFT JOIN doctor d ON a.doctor_id = d.id LEFT JOIN schedule s ON a.schedule_id = s.id WHERE a.patient_id = #{patientId} ORDER BY a.appointment_time DESC
select * from appointment where patient_id = #{patientId}
select * from appointment where doctor_id = #{doctorId} order by appointment_time desc
select * from appointment where schedule_id = #{scheduleId} order by created_at desc
select count(*) from appointment where schedule_id = #{scheduleId} and status != 'CANCELLED'
mapper.insert: insert into appointment(patient_id, doctor_id, schedule_id, appointment_time, status, fee, actual_fee, created_at, source_type, auto_assigned, reschedule_window_expires) values (#{patientId}, #{doctorId}, #{scheduleId}, #{appointmentTime}, #{status}, #{fee}, #{actualFee}, now(), #{sourceType}, #{autoAssigned}, #{rescheduleWindowExpires})
mapper.select: select * from appointment where id = #{id}
mapper.update: update appointment set status = #{status} where id = #{id}

update appointment set patient_id = #{patientId}, doctor_id = #{doctorId}, schedule_id = #{scheduleId}, appointment_time = #{appointmentTime}, status = #{status}, fee = #{fee}, actual_fee = #{actualFee}, source_type = #{sourceType}, auto_assigned = #{autoAssigned}, reschedule_window_expires = #{rescheduleWindowExpires} where id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT DATE(a.appointment_time) AS date, COUNT(*) AS totalCount, SUM(CASE WHEN a.status = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completedCount, SUM(CASE WHEN a.status = 'CANCELLED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cancelledCount, SUM(CASE WHEN a.status = 'NO_SHOW' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS noShowCount, SUM(CASE WHEN a.status = 'SCHEDULED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS scheduledCount, SUM(a.actual_fee) AS totalRevenue FROM appointment a WHERE a.appointment_time >= #{startDate} AND a.appointment_time < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY DATE(a.appointment_time) ORDER BY date

SELECT dept.id AS departmentId, dept.name AS departmentName, COUNT(DISTINCT d.id) AS doctorCount, COUNT(a.id) AS totalCount, SUM(CASE WHEN a.status = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completedCount, SUM(CASE WHEN a.status = 'CANCELLED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cancelledCount, SUM(a.actual_fee) AS totalRevenue, COALESCE(SUM(s.total_slots), 0) AS totalSlots, COALESCE(SUM(s.total_slots - s.available_slots), 0) AS usedSlots FROM appointment a LEFT JOIN doctor d ON a.doctor_id = d.id LEFT JOIN clinic c ON d.clinic_id = c.id LEFT JOIN department dept ON c.department_id = dept.id LEFT JOIN schedule s ON a.schedule_id = s.id WHERE a.appointment_time >= #{startDate} AND a.appointment_time < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY dept.id, dept.name ORDER BY totalCount DESC

SELECT dept.id AS departmentId, dept.name AS departmentName, COUNT(a.id) AS appointmentCount, SUM(a.fee) AS originalFee, SUM(a.actual_fee) AS totalRevenue, SUM(a.actual_fee) AS actualFee FROM appointment a LEFT JOIN doctor d ON a.doctor_id = d.id LEFT JOIN clinic c ON d.clinic_id = c.id LEFT JOIN department dept ON c.department_id = dept.id WHERE a.appointment_time >= #{startDate} AND a.appointment_time < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND a.status != 'CANCELLED' GROUP BY dept.id, dept.name ORDER BY totalRevenue DESC

SELECT dept.id AS departmentId, dept.name AS departmentName, COUNT(a.id) AS totalCount, SUM(CASE WHEN a.status = 'CANCELLED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cancelledCount, CASE WHEN COUNT(a.id) > 0 THEN ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN a.status = 'CANCELLED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(a.id), 2) ELSE 0 END AS cancellationRate FROM appointment a LEFT JOIN doctor d ON a.doctor_id = d.id LEFT JOIN clinic c ON d.clinic_id = c.id LEFT JOIN department dept ON c.department_id = dept.id WHERE a.appointment_time >= #{startDate} AND a.appointment_time < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY dept.id, dept.name HAVING totalCount > 0 ORDER BY cancellationRate DESC
SELECT * FROM appointment WHERE source_type = 'RESCHEDULED' AND created_at <= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{hours} HOUR)

SELECT p.id AS patientId, p.name, p.phone_number AS phoneNumber, p.specific_role AS specificRole, -- 最近一次预约信息 MAX(a.appointment_time) AS lastVisitDate, -- 下一次预约信息（未来的预约） MIN(CASE WHEN a.appointment_time > NOW() THEN a.appointment_time ELSE NULL END) AS nextAppointmentDate, (SELECT a2.id FROM appointment a2 WHERE a2.patient_id = p.id AND a2.doctor_id = #{doctorId} AND a2.appointment_time > NOW() ORDER BY a2.appointment_time LIMIT 1) AS nextAppointmentId, (SELECT s.time_slot FROM appointment a3 JOIN schedule s ON a3.schedule_id = s.id WHERE a3.patient_id = p.id AND a3.doctor_id = #{doctorId} AND a3.appointment_time > NOW() ORDER BY a3.appointment_time LIMIT 1) AS nextAppointmentTimeSlot, -- 统计信息 COUNT(a.id) AS totalAppointments, SUM(CASE WHEN a.status = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completedAppointments FROM patient p INNER JOIN appointment a ON p.id = a.patient_id WHERE a.doctor_id = #{doctorId} GROUP BY p.id, p.name, p.phone_number, p.specific_role ORDER BY MAX(a.appointment_time) DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalAppointments, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completedAppointments, MAX(appointment_time) AS lastVisitDate, (SELECT status FROM appointment WHERE patient_id = #{patientId} AND doctor_id = #{doctorId} ORDER BY appointment_time DESC LIMIT 1) AS lastVisitStatus, (SELECT CASE WHEN status = 'SCHEDULED' THEN '已预约' WHEN status = 'CONFIRMED' THEN '已确认' WHEN status = 'COMPLETED' THEN '已完成' WHEN status = 'CANCELLED' THEN '已取消' WHEN status = 'NOSHOW' THEN '未到诊' ELSE '未知' END FROM appointment WHERE patient_id = #{patientId} AND doctor_id = #{doctorId} ORDER BY appointment_time DESC LIMIT 1) AS lastStatusName FROM appointment WHERE patient_id = #{patientId} AND doctor_id = #{doctorId}
